scope: Strict success response contract for the private location-scoped irrigation-zone status endpoint.

constraints.zone_status: active zones only, matching the service query
constraints.schedule_status: pending only, matching the lateral schedule query
constraints.moisture_status: limited to the five service-derived states
constraints.zone_page: at most 50 rows and no more than the requested limit
constraints.pagination: returned limit and offset must match request; has_more must agree with total and page count
constraints.request_path: returned location identifier must match requested location
constraints.privacy: device identifiers and arbitrary metadata are not part of the response model
constraints.validation: Explicitly validate the service projection before returning JSONResponse

error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes one source/API response contract only; live OIDC behavior, populated-data parity, and broader tenant isolation remain separate gates.
